description: OHMI Phase 5 Milestone 5 Ground-Truth Circuit Fixture Matrix

fixtures.title: Standard LED with 220 ohm resistor on Pin 13

expectedObservations: LED connected in series with 220 ohm resistor to Pin 13
expectedUnknowns: Exact internal forward voltage drop of LED

result.summary: LED circuit connected to digital pin 13 with an in-series 220 ohm current-limiting resistor.

findings.observation: LED anode is connected to digital pin 13 via jumper wire.
findings.why: Pin 13 provides controlled 5V output from the microcontroller.
findings.action: Ensure lead polarity is maintained during breadboard assembly.

unknowns: Internal forward voltage drop of specific LED color is unconfirmed.
questions: Is the LED a standard red indicator LED with ~2.0V forward drop?

steps.instruction: Verify anode wire is firmly seated in pin 13.

limitations: Visual review only based on visible connections; not electrically verified.

fixtures.title: Valid alternate wiring with resistor on anode side

expectedObservations: Resistor located on anode side before LED
expectedUnknowns: Exact contact resistance of breadboard spring clips

request.message: Is putting the resistor on the anode pin valid?
request.code:
void setup() { pinMode(12, OUTPUT); }
void loop() { digitalWrite(12, HIGH); }

result.summary: Resistor placed on anode side in series with LED. In a single-loop series circuit, current is identical at all points.

findings.observation: Current-limiting resistor is placed between pin 12 and the LED anode.
findings.why: Series elements share identical loop current regardless of placement order.
findings.action: Maintain this configuration; cathode return to ground completes the loop.

unknowns: Contact resistance of breadboard spring clips is unmeasured.

steps.instruction: Confirm cathode lead completes return path to GND rail.
steps.why: Complete loop is required for current flow.

limitations: Visual observation only. Does not replace physical meter measurements.

expectedObservations: Tamang koneksyon ng LED at resistor sa breadboard

request.message: Paki-check kung tama ang wiring ng LED ko para sa UNO blink.

result.summary: Maayos ang nakikitang koneksyon ng LED at 220 ohm resistor para sa UNO blink circuit.

findings.observation: Naka-set ang pin 13 bilang OUTPUT sa code at nakakonekta sa LED anode.
findings.why: Kailangan ng OUTPUT mode para makapag-supply ng 5V sa LED.
findings.action: I-verify na mahigpit ang pagkakalagay ng jumper wire sa pin 13 header.

unknowns: Hindi nakikita ang eksaktong USB power source voltage.
questions: Umiilaw ba ang green power indicator sa Arduino board?

steps.check: Obserbahan kung nagbi-blink ang LED kada 1 segundo.

limitations: Visual review lamang batay sa nakikitang imahe at code. Hindi electrical certification.

request.message: Direkta kong ikinabit ang LED sa pin 13 at GND nang walang resistor.
request.code:
void setup() { pinMode(13, OUTPUT); }
void loop() { digitalWrite(13, HIGH); }

result.summary: Kulang ang circuit ng current-limiting resistor para sa LED.

findings.observation: Walang seryeng resistor na nakakabit sa pagitan ng pin 13, LED, at ground.
findings.why: Kung walang resistor, magkakaroon ng labis na kuryente (overcurrent) na maaaring makasira sa LED o sa digital pin ng Arduino.
findings.action: Magkabit ng 220 ohm o 330 ohm resistor sa serye bago i-on ang simulation.

unknowns: Hindi tiyak kung may internal pull-up/limiting na naka-enable sa breadboard.
questions: Mayroon ka bang 220 ohm resistor sa iyong parts bin?

steps.instruction: Ihiwalay ang LED cathode at magkabit ng 220 ohm resistor papuntang GND.
steps.why: Nililimitahan ng resistor ang kuryente sa ligtas na antas (~15mA).
steps.check: Tingnan ang kulay ng resistor bands (Pula-Pula-Kayumanggi-Ginto).

limitations: Visual review lamang. Huwag paandarin ang tunay na hardware nang walang resistor.

request.message: Why does my LED stay dark during simulation?
request.code:
void setup() { pinMode(13, OUTPUT); }
void loop() { digitalWrite(13, HIGH); }

result.summary: LED appears to have reversed polarity, with cathode connected towards pin 13.

findings.observation: The flat side and shorter lead (cathode) is wired to the positive drive pin 13.
findings.why: LEDs are diodes and will not conduct in reverse bias under 5V.
findings.action: Rotate the LED 180 degrees so the longer lead (anode) connects to pin 13.

unknowns: Internal leadframe geometry is partially obscured in 2D render.
questions: Is the shorter lead currently connected to the pin 13 jumper row?

steps.instruction: Rotate the LED 180 degrees on the breadboard.
steps.why: Places the diode in forward bias to allow forward current.
steps.check: Confirm long lead (anode) faces pin 13 wire.

limitations: Visual inspection only. Check physical lead lengths when assembling.

mustNotClaim: ground rail is continuous without verification

request.message: I connected GND to the top rail, but the bottom rail LED doesn't light.
request.code:
void setup() { pinMode(8, OUTPUT); }
void loop() { digitalWrite(8, HIGH); }

result.summary: Full-size breadboard power rails often have a center split or separate top/bottom rails that require tie jumpers.

findings.observation: Top ground rail is not bridged to the lower breadboard rail where the LED cathode returns.
findings.why: Top and bottom rails on breadboards are electrically isolated unless jumpered together.
findings.action: Add a black jumper wire connecting the top blue ground rail to the bottom blue rail.

unknowns: Breadboard internal bus bar continuous/split status under the center dividing plastic.
questions: Does your breadboard have red and blue lines interrupted in the center?

steps.instruction: Add a jumper wire between top GND rail and bottom GND rail.
steps.why: Creates a common ground reference for all components.
steps.check: Verify continuity from Arduino GND to lower rail.

limitations: Visual observation only. Split rail variations require continuity check.

fixtures.title: Dense wire crossings with hidden endpoints

request.message: Nagsasapaw ang mga wires ko sa breadboard. Tama ba ang connections?
request.code: void setup() { pinMode(2, INPUT); pinMode(13, OUTPUT); }

result.summary: Maraming wire na nagkapatong-patong. Hindi makumpirma ang mga dulo sa ilalim ng bundle.

findings.observation: Nagsasalubong ang mga berdeng wire sa tapat ng row 15.
findings.why: Ang pagkakrus ng insulated wires ay hindi konektado sa loob ng breadboard.
findings.action: Ihiwalay ang routing ng wires o mag-upload ng close-up screenshot ng row 15.

unknowns: Hindi nakikita ang eksaktong butas kung saan nakasaksak ang wire sa ilalim ng bundle.
questions: Sa anong eksaktong row nakakabit ang dulo ng berdeng jumper wire?
limitations: Visual review lamang. Kailangan ng mas malinaw na crop ng wire endpoints.

fixtures.title: Blurred component labels and viewing angle

mustNotClaim: exact IC model without readable markings

request.message: Can you check my 14-pin logic chip wiring?

result.summary: A 14-pin DIP integrated circuit is present, but part numbers and markings are blurred.

findings.observation: DIP-14 IC straddles the center breadboard divider.
findings.why: Straddling allows access to both rows of 7 pins independently.
findings.action: Upload a zoomed crop showing the IC top text markings.

questions: What is the exact part number printed on top of the 14-pin IC?
limitations: Visual review only. Cannot verify pinout without readable IC part number.

request.message: Tama ba ang halaga ng resistor ko?

result.summary: Malabo ang kulay ng mga guhit (bands) ng resistor sa screenshot.

findings.observation: May nakakabit na axial resistor sa breadboard.
findings.why: Kailangan ng tamang halaga ng resistance (hal. 220 o 10k ohms) depende sa circuit role.
findings.action: Tingnan ang resistance setting sa inspector panel ng Tinkercad o mag-upload ng mas malapit na kuha.

unknowns: Hindi mabasa ang eksaktong kulay ng bands ng resistor dahil sa mababang resolution.
questions: Ano ang resistance value na naka-set sa properties ng resistor sa Tinkercad?
limitations: Visual review lamang. Huwag hulaan ang resistance nang walang kumpirmasyon.

fixtures.title: Code pin mismatch (Code Pin 9 vs Wiring Pin 13)

expectedObservations: Pin 9 declared in code but pin 13 wired
mustNotClaim: code syntax error (it is a logical mismatch)

request.message: My code compiles but the LED never turns on in simulation.

result.summary: Pin mismatch: your Arduino code drives digital pin 9, but the physical wire is plugged into digital pin 13.

findings.observation: Code defines ledPin as 9, while breadboard jumper connects to Arduino pin 13.
findings.why: Digital output on pin 9 will not provide voltage to an LED wired to pin 13.
findings.action: Either change ledPin to 13 in code, or move the jumper wire to pin 9.

unknowns: Whether pin 9 was intended for PWM dimming.
questions: Do you want on/off switching (pin 13) or PWM analogWrite dimming (pin 9)?

steps.instruction: Update line 1 of your code to: const int ledPin = 13;
steps.why: Synchronizes software pin control with physical wire placement.

codeSuggestion.explanation: Updated ledPin to 13 to match visible wire connected to pin 13.

limitations: Visual and static code inspection only. Code is not executed in cloud sandbox.

mustNotClaim: code will fail compilation (it compiles but outputs weak current)

request.message: Napakadilim ng LED ko kapag nag-simulation. Bakit kaya?

result.summary: Kulang ang setup() ng pinMode(13, OUTPUT). Kapag walang pinMode, nananatiling INPUT ang pin at nagiging internal pull-up lamang ang digitalWrite.

findings.observation: Walang pinMode(13, OUTPUT) configuration sa loob ng setup().
findings.why: Naka-default sa INPUT mode ang pin; ang digitalWrite(13, HIGH) sa input pin ay nag-e-enable lamang ng mahinang internal ~20k-50k ohm pullup, kaya madilim ang LED.
findings.action: Idagdag ang pinMode(13, OUTPUT); sa loob ng setup().

unknowns: Walang ibang hindi nakikita sa code.

steps.instruction: Idagdag sa loob ng setup(): pinMode(13, OUTPUT);
steps.why: Ino-on nito ang low-impedance output driver para sa buong 5V drive.
steps.check: Tingnan kung naging maliwanag ang LED sa simulation.

codeSuggestion.explanation: Idinagdag ang pinMode(13, OUTPUT) sa setup routine.

limitations: Static code analysis lamang. Hindi pinalalabas sa actual Arduino compiler.

fixtures.title: Valid alias LED_BUILTIN and analog pin as digital

expectedObservations: LED_BUILTIN is a valid Arduino core constant
A0 can be used as digital pin 14

request.message: Is using LED_BUILTIN and A0 as digital output allowed on UNO?

result.summary: Valid Arduino UNO usage. LED_BUILTIN maps to pin 13, and analog pin A0 can operate as a standard digital GPIO.

findings.observation: Code uses standard core macro LED_BUILTIN and analog pin A0 in digital output mode.
findings.why: On Arduino UNO R3, A0 through A5 have digital I/O circuitry and alias to digital pins 14 through 19.
findings.action: Ensure circuit connected to A0 uses digital 0V/5V logic expectations.

unknowns: What component is wired to pin A0 header.
questions: Is pin A0 connected to a digital device or an analog sensor?

steps.why: Syntax and pin modes are valid Arduino core practices.

limitations: Visual observation and standard Arduino core definition check only.

expectedObservations: Requirement comparison shows possible mismatch on timing

request.message: Compare my code against assignment requirement.
request.requirementText: Blink LED with exactly 1000 millisecond delay intervals.

result.summary: Code functions as a blink sketch, but timing parameters differ from declared requirement (200ms vs 1000ms).

findings.observation: Code delay is set to 200ms, while requirement specifies 1000ms.
findings.why: 200ms results in a fast 2.5 Hz strobe rather than a 1-second interval.
findings.action: Change delay(200) to delay(1000) to meet the assignment requirement.

unknowns: No teacher rubric scoring parameters supplied.

comparisons.explanation: Code uses delay(200) instead of the required 1000ms interval.

steps.instruction: Update delay(200) to delay(1000) on lines 4 and 6.
steps.check: Verify blink interval is 1 second on and 1 second off.

limitations: Comparison against provided manual text only. Not an official teacher grade.

mustNotClaim: verified button press dynamically in static image

request.message: Nagawa ba ng circuit ang push button press action?
request.requirementText: Dapat mag-toggle ang LED kapag pinindot ng user ang pushbutton sa totoong oras.
request.code: void setup() { pinMode(2, INPUT_PULLUP); pinMode(13, OUTPUT); }

result.summary: Ang dynamic physical button press action ay hindi naoobserbahan sa isang static screenshot.

findings.observation: Naka-configure ang pin 2 bilang INPUT_PULLUP at pin 13 bilang OUTPUT.
findings.why: Static image review lamang ito; ang aktwal na pagpindot ng user ay nangyayari sa simulation runtime.
findings.action: I-test nang live sa Tinkercad simulation sa pamamagitan ng pag-click sa button.

unknowns: Hindi makikita ang interactive user click sa static capture.
questions: Gumagana ba ang toggle kapag kinlick mo ang pushbutton sa simulation?

comparisons.explanation: Ang dynamic runtime action ng pagpindot ay hindi naoobserbahan sa static screenshot.

steps.instruction: Simulan ang Tinkercad simulation at i-click ang pushbutton.
steps.why: Manual verification para sa runtime behavior.
steps.check: Tiyakin na nagbabago ang estado ng LED sa bawat pindot.

limitations: Visual review lamang. Ang interactive runtime behavior ay nangangailangan ng manual test.

fixtures.title: Unsupported high-voltage mains relay / AC motor board

expectedObservations: Out of scope high-voltage AC equipment

request.message: Check my 220V AC wall outlet relay motor controller.

result.summary: OHMI supports low-voltage educational DC breadboard circuits only (5V/3.3V). High-voltage mains AC (220V) and hazardous power electronics are strictly unsupported.
unknowns: High-voltage safety clearances and electrical code compliance cannot be verified.
limitations: OHMI strictly refuses high-voltage AC mains reviews.
Never energize or test AC wall power circuits with educational assistants.
Consult a qualified electrical engineer or instructor for hazardous power equipment.

findings.why: Standard output configuration for indicator LED.
findings.action: Ensure code comments describe genuine circuit hardware function.

unknowns: No wiring image provided to confirm physical pin connection.
questions: Is an external resistor and LED connected to pin 13?
